share.message:
Download Zikr App and share it with others to spread the benefit 📱✨

🌟 Features:
• Authentic daily prayers & supplications 📖
• Interactive digital tasbih counter with audio feedback 📿
• Prayer times with multiple calculation methods ⏰
• Qibla direction with compass 🧭
• Full Arabic & English support with RTL/LTR layout 🌐
• User-friendly interface with favorites system ⭐

📱 Download:
Web Version: https://zikr.valabji.com
Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.valabji.zikr

🍎 For iPhone - App Store version coming soon, but you can now:
1. Open the web version link in Safari browser
2. Tap the Share icon (square with arrow)
3. Scroll down and select "Add to Home Screen"
4. Tap "Add" - the app will appear as an icon on your home screen

about.title: About
about.description: Zikr is a free Islamic companion grounded in the Quran and the authentic Sunnah upon the understanding of the righteous predecessors (the Salaf). It brings together authentic azkar and a digital tasbih, the Holy Quran with recitations and tafsir, prayer times and Qibla direction, an Islamic library and Quran radio, the Hijri calendar, and tools to track your prayers, wird and memorization in both Arabic and English.
